description: Willoughby Street Parking Signs is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. The raw street parking sign data from Willoughby Council is available only for the Chatswood CBD. The data is supplied in KML format, with the raw data also available as a CSV. Photographs for each sign are provided via embedded links and are included in the CSV. willoughby. nsw. gov. au/Home. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are Chatswood, Willoughby, council, geospatial, opendata. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, kml. The portal shows 2026-05-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
